# Index-zero address-book selection notification

At revision 0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, displayAddressBook explicitly dispatches a select event when the selected index is 0. The source comment explains that index 0 was selected before selection listeners were attached. Changes to this navigation path should preserve that notification for the already-selected row. This applies after initialAddressBook is false; the earlier branch returns before this code. This is a scoped source observation, with no runtime validation supplied.

Scope: Address-book selection events.
